title: I addressed some feedback I got from my Demo, would love anyone interested to give it another try!
author: Crignog

comments.author: RUSuper
comments.body: This trees much better than the ones you had before as 2D. Did you use ink shader like I suggested in your previous post? It looks to me there is more focus on tree outlines. I love the look of it. I just think that now models stand out too much as not part of the same set heh.

replies.author: Crignog
replies.body: Hey thanks! Do you have a link to something with an ink shader so I can see what you mean? I just introduced an outline shader for 3D objects, is that what you meant by Ink? You mean the trees compared to the buildings? Would be interested to hear more about how they could look like they both belong :)

replies.author: RUSuper
replies.body:
That is it yeah, outline shader, I call it "ink" because it looks like it is "ink" on the edges haha ⬇️ 

No I mean these small guys look a bit out of place, I think you will have to move them to 3D characters also :D

https://preview.redd.it/67pvnfdgsmth1.png?width=316&format=png&auto=webp&s=e38cb51d028253c62bb0a2c500cf6a74eba71343

replies.author: Crignog
replies.body: Okay I absolutely appreciate that, thank you! You are the second person to say this. In my head I wanted a more HD2D game, where units are sprites and everything else is 3D. But if that's what people would prefer then I might have to seriously consider it haha
